name: Black & Gold Dispatch data API
disclaimer: Unofficial fan site. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Pittsburgh Steelers or the NFL.
terms: Unofficial fan site. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the Pittsburgh Steelers or the NFL. Headlines and links belong to their original publishers; we grant no rights in them. Summaries, grades, ratings, rumor tiers, needs and board rankings and analysis are written by Black & Gold Dispatch: credit 'Black & Gold Dispatch' and link to the original publisher (the `url` field). Scores, schedule, stats, depth chart, injuries and the stats behind stats-based grades come from nflverse (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data), licensed CC-BY 4.0: you may reuse them if you credit 'Data: nflverse (CC-BY 4.0)'. College prospect stats come from CollegeFootballData.com (https://collegefootballdata.com): credit 'Data: CollegeFootballData.com'; we grant no rights in their data. Wikipedia-derived facts are CC BY-SA 4.0 (credit Wikipedia). Social posts are not reproduced; follow the link to the author. Do not republish full articles.

premium.scope: Black & Gold Dispatch's own content only (fan grades, ratings, summaries, rumor tiers, rankings, analysis). Never headlines, social posts, ESPN data, nflverse data, third-party mock boards or Wikipedia text. Pending attorney review.

datasets.name: news
datasets.description: Steelers headlines from beat writers, national outlets and blogs, with our one-line summaries and links to the publisher.

datasets.name: rumors
datasets.description: Today's Steelers rumors (US Eastern day) with source reliability tier, status (Rumor/Confirmed/Denied), first-seen/updated times and consensus (independent sources, highest tier).

datasets.name: injuries
datasets.description: Current Steelers injury designations from the official NFL injury report and reserve lists (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0): status and injury.

datasets.name: depth-chart
datasets.description: Steelers depth chart by unit and position, 1st/2nd/3rd string with injury tags (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).

datasets.name: schedule
datasets.description: Steelers season schedule and results (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).

datasets.name: stats
datasets.description: Steelers team stats with league ranks, and player stats (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).

datasets.name: grades
datasets.description: Per-game player grades: transparent stats grade from the box score until 25 fan votes, then fan grade.

datasets.name: college
datasets.description: College prospects at the Steelers' top needs with last-game and season stats (CollegeFootballData.com) and recent headlines.

datasets.name: insiders
datasets.description: Last 3 days of public posts from NFL insiders and Steelers beat writers (links only).

datasets.name: podcasts
datasets.description: Today's Steelers podcast episodes and YouTube videos (links).

datasets.name: film
datasets.description: Film breakdowns of the last game and previews of the next game (links).

datasets.name: draft
datasets.description: Steelers draft hub: top prospects per need with our estimated chance each is available at the Steelers' projected picks, published analyst grades of the last class (letter + link), and every past Steelers pick (nflverse, CC-BY 4.0).
